rules.statement: A District Court has jurisdiction over a suit against a defendant who resides within the district, or where the cause of action arose, or where the land in respect of which the action is brought lies.
rules.supporting_quote: "Every district court shall have cognizance of and full power to hear and determine all pleas, suits, and actions in which a party defendant shall be resident within the district in which any such suit or action shall be brought, or in which the cause of action shall have arisen within such district, or where the land in respect of which the action is brought lies, or is situate wholly or partly, within such district."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 65 of The Courts Jurisdiction Ordinance, No. 1 of 1889.
